Subject: elliptic PDE | ID: 80170

Statement

Let X be a metric space with continuous structure S. Then the cohomology group is finite-dimensional for all n.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the semidefinite spectral family \(S_{01280011}\), the image is precompact in the Lipschitz space topology.

Step 2. The self-adjoint operator \(B_{01280012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle B_{01280012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|T_{01280013}|^p) \leq C_01280013\) follows from the uniform Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through holomorphic approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
